purpose.zh: 单腿臀桥，练臀大肌伸髋（每侧）
purpose.en: Practice a single-leg hip bridge with a level pelvis.

text.zh: 一条腿抬起，用臀部把身体推高
text.en: One leg up, drive your hips up with your glutes

text.zh: 左脚稳定支撑，保持骨盆朝向一致
text.en: Keep the left foot planted and the pelvis level.

text.zh: 缓慢放回起始位，不用腰部猛顶
text.en: Lower slowly to the starting position without thrusting through the lower back.

commonErrors.zh: 抬起时骨盆明显倾斜或旋转
commonErrors.en: Tilting or rotating the pelvis as you lift.

commonErrors.zh: 借腰部过度后仰代替臀部发力
commonErrors.en: Overarching the lower back instead of driving through the hip.

cautions.zh: 腰背：抬髋来自臀部，避免用过度拱腰换取高度。
cautions.en: Lower back: lift through the hips rather than forcing extra height by arching the lower back.

cautions.zh: 骨盆与支撑脚：保持骨盆平稳、左脚稳定支撑，下降时继续控制。
cautions.en: Pelvis and support foot: keep the pelvis level and the left foot planted while lowering under control.

cautions.zh: 颈肩：头和肩胛区域舒适承托，不把体重压在颈部。
cautions.en: Neck and shoulders: keep the head and shoulder-blade area comfortably supported rather than loading the neck.
